items.name: dialog-drawer
items.title: Dialog Drawer
items.description: A responsive Dialog for Base UI: a centered Dialog at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Dialog — desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a drawer={{}} override typed 1:1 on the Drawer API.

items.name: sheet-drawer
items.title: Sheet Drawer
items.description: A responsive Sheet for Base UI: a side Sheet at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Sheet — desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a drawer={{}} override typed 1:1 on the Drawer API.

items.name: popover-drawer
items.title: Popover Drawer
items.description: A responsive Popover for Base UI: an anchored Popover at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Popover — desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a drawer={{}} override typed 1:1 on the Drawer API.

items.name: tooltip-popover
items.title: Tooltip Popover
items.description: A responsive Tooltip for Base UI: a hover Tooltip at desktop that becomes a tap-to-open Popover below 768px, because hover does not exist on touch. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Tooltip — desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a popover={{}} override typed 1:1 on the Popover API.

items.name: dialog-drawer-radix
items.title: Dialog Drawer (Radix)
items.description: A responsive Dialog for Radix: a centered Dialog at desktop that becomes a swipeable Vaul Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Dialog — desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a drawer={{}} override typed 1:1 on the Drawer API.
